ELA / 6-8

Argument Evidence Quality Sort

A quick sorting activity for ranking evidence as strong, partial, weak, or irrelevant.

NYS framework label
NYS Next Generation ELA Learning Standards
Alignment note
Supports argument reading and writing by evaluating relevance and sufficiency of evidence.
Classroom use case
Use before drafting an argument paragraph so students defend why evidence belongs.

Preview

  • Strong: directly proves the claim
  • Partial: related but needs explanation
  • Weak: interesting but does not prove the claim
